While most of the story unfolds at a natural, real-time pace suitable for a short dialogue, there is a jarring and unrealistic compression of time near the end. The scene is explicitly set in the afternoon ("Nachmittag"), and the characters have just received their coffee. Immediately after, the stage direction states, "Long pause. Outside it gets dark" (*Lange Pause. Draußen wird es dunkel.*). Compressing what would likely be hours of silence—from the afternoon until nightfall—into a single pause between lines of dialogue feels unbalanced and disrupts the realistic pacing established in the rest of the scene.
